# Vendored, not fetched

`xterm.js`, `addon-fit.js` and `xterm.css` are committed here rather than
pulled from a CDN, because the dashboard ships inside a desktop app and has to
work with no network.

- **xterm.js** — https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js — MIT License,

Its licence is MIT, the same as this project's; the notice above is the
attribution that licence asks for. These files are unmodified upstream builds.
